answer: Every identity locks collateral in a bonded escrow, so splitting stake does not erase exposure. If k coordinated identities equivocate on the same conflicting messages, their correlated penalty scales as O(k^2), not linearly. Detection applies asymmetric depreciation to seized bonds, creating an exponential multiplier in capital loss for a sybil swarm. Whether nodes sit on an island, beside a lagoon, or use ferrous hardware, penalties follow proven coordination, not location.
